sources: zika_congenital
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/zika-virus-congenital-infection-guidance-for-neonatologists-and-paediatricians
UKHSA congenital Zika guidance
management of neonates after possible maternal Zika exposure
The guidance is for neonatologists and paediatricians managing neonates after possible maternal exposure.
It covers examination, laboratory testing, imaging and follow-up where congenital infection cannot be excluded.
zika_stats
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/laboratory-confirmed-zika-virus-disease-cases-statistics
UKHSA laboratory-confirmed Zika statistics
provisional Zika surveillance by month and reported country of travel
The publication provides epidemiological data on laboratory-confirmed Zika cases.
The datasets are provisional and final analyses appear in travel-associated infection reports.
adult_social_collection
https://www.gov.uk/government/collections/adult-social-care-guidance
DHSC and UKHSA adult social care guidance collection
infection prevention, workforce and care-planning guidance for adult social care
The collection brings together national guidance for the adult social care sector.
Its IPC section links respiratory, HCID, visiting, PPE and multidrug-resistant-organism guidance.
asc_ipc_landing
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/infection-prevention-and-control-in-adult-social-care-settings
DHSC adult social care IPC publication
general infection-prevention principles for adult social care settings
The publication sets out general IPC principles for adult social care in England.
It is intended for people responsible for setting and maintaining IPC standards.
asc_ipc_resource
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/infection-prevention-and-control-in-adult-social-care-settings/infection-prevention-and-control-resource-for-adult-social-care
UKHSA adult social care IPC resource
risk assessment and standard infection-control precautions in adult social care
The resource requires infection risk assessment before and during use of care services.
It covers standard precautions including hand hygiene, respiratory hygiene, PPE, cleaning, laundry and waste.
asc_ipc_quick
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/infection-prevention-and-control-in-adult-social-care-settings/infection-prevention-and-control-quick-guide-for-care-workers
UKHSA IPC quick guide for care workers
practical IPC measures for frontline adult social care workers
The quick guide covers hand hygiene, respiratory hygiene, PPE, cleaning, laundry and waste disposal.
It states that limiting infection spread is a responsibility shared by all care workers.
asc_ari_landing
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/infection-prevention-and-control-in-adult-social-care-acute-respiratory-infection
UKHSA adult social care ARI publication
IPC measures for viral acute respiratory infections in adult social care
The publication covers measures to reduce viral acute respiratory infection transmission in adult social care.
It applies to providers, managers, staff and other people involved in services in England.
asc_ari_detail

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/infection-prevention-and-control-in-adult-social-care-acute-respiratory-infection/infection-prevention-and-control-ipc-in-adult-social-care-acute-respiratory-infection-ari
UKHSA detailed adult social care ARI guidance
symptom management, testing, isolation, PPE and outbreak response in adult social care
The detailed guidance combines standard precautions with proportionate outbreak management.
It defines a suspected care-home ARI outbreak as 2 or more linked cases within 5 days.
asc_hcid

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/managing-cases-of-suspected-high-consequence-infectious-diseases-in-adult-social-care/principles-for-managing-cases-of-suspected-high-consequence-infectious-diseases-in-adult-social-care
UKHSA suspected HCID principles for adult social care
interim protection and care before NHS transfer of a suspected HCID case
The guidance covers actions between professional suspicion of an HCID and NHS transfer.
It requires health-protection advice, isolation support, appropriate PPE and contact records.
